question: Which of the following is an example of micronutrient supplied by soil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron** is a **micronutrient** that is essential for **plant growth and development.**
 
• It is typically found in the soil in small amounts and is taken up by plants through their **roots.**
 
• Iron plays a key role in the **production of chlorophyll**, which is necessary for** photosynthesis.**
 
• Iron deficiencies in plants can lead to **stunted growth, chlorosis **(yellowing of the leaves), and **reduced yield.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Potassium (K)** is an essential nutrient for plant growth. It's classified as a **macronutrient** because plants take up large quantities of K during their life cycle.
 
• **Calcium** is a macronutrient that is needed in large amounts by plants **for cell wall structure** and other functions.
 
• **Sulphur** is also a macronutrient that is important for** amino acid and protein synthesis** in plants.
